history.title: Run history
history.caption: Every run, with what it removed and why. Kept for {{days, number}} days or the last {{runs, number}} runs, whichever keeps more.

empty.title: No runs yet

empty.bodyNoStatus: To see what it would remove right now, choose Clean now.

rules.trigger: What the janitor removes and never touches

removes.heading: Removes, on its own
removes.tasks: Exited task containers beyond the newest {{keep, number}} per service slot.
removes.standalone: On a standalone host: exited containers of a compose project that no longer exists, and exited one-off compose run containers.
removes.images: Dangling images: untagged, used by no container on that node, and older than {{grace}}.
removes.networks: Orphaned networks: the stack that created them no longer exists.

reports.heading: Only reports, until you opt in

never.heading: Never touches
never.running: Running, paused, restarting or created containers.
never.kept: Anything labelled tierplan.keep=true, anything you chose Keep on, and everything a stack that is excluded from the janitor owns.
never.deploy: Anything while a deploy is running in this environment.

rules.labelBefore: To protect something, add the label
rules.labelAfter: to it in your compose file. To protect something that already exists and can't be relabelled, choose Keep on it in a preview.
